dataset_name: Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) 12k Drive End Bearing Dataset
testbed_specification: Reliance Electric 2 HP Induction Motor with Deep Groove Ball Bearings (6205-2RS JEM SKF)

simulation_to_real_transfer_evaluation.transfer_finding: Direct zero-shot transfer from mathematical simulation to physical CWRU signals experiences a 25.6% accuracy drop due to real structural transmission path resonances and non-ideal impulse decay rates. Fine-tuning with as few as 20 real windows restores accuracy to >92%.
